side_missions.title: Harmonic Dissonance
side_missions.description: Strange resonance patterns have been detected in the Fairy Realms — whisper crystals singing in frequencies that shouldn't exist. The Fairy Collective is spooked, and Aristotle's crystal sense is tingling. Something ancient is waking up.

objectives.description: Track the anomalous crystal resonance to its source
Collect harmonic data from three crystal nodes
Report findings to the Fairy Collective

side_missions.title: Whispers in the Mane Hall
side_missions.description: Lord Mane's court is fracturing. A faction within the Lion Dominion is quietly arming for civil war, and someone is feeding them classified crystal shipment routes. Aristotle needs to find the mole before the Prides shatter entirely.

objectives.description: Attend the Lion Dominion court gathering
Identify the informant leaking crystal routes

side_missions.title: The Bazaar Job
side_missions.description: An unknown party is stockpiling intelligence on every faction's crystal reserves at the Twilight Bazaar. If that data gets sold to the wrong buyer, the balance of power crumbles overnight. Aristotle needs to get to it first.

objectives.description: Find the hidden intelligence cache in the Bazaar
Steal or destroy the crystal intelligence files
Escape the Bazaar before security closes in

side_missions.title: The Trail of Cold Stars
side_missions.description: Ships have been vanishing in the outer Fairy Realms — no wreckage, no distress calls, just gone. The locals whisper about Death walking the starlanes. Aristotle decides to follow the trail before it leads to his own crew.

objectives.description: Search the last known coordinates of missing ships
Confront whatever lurks at the end of the trail
